articles.title_en: Persistence in a dynamic moral hazard game
articles.title_cn: 动态道德风险博弈中的持续性
authors: Bohren, J. Aislinn (Department of Economics, University of Pennsylvania)
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies how the persistence of past choices can be used to create incentives in a continuous time stochastic game. A large player, such as a firm, interacts with a sequence of small players, such as customers. The large player faces moral hazard and her actions are imperfectly observed---they are distorted by a Brownian motion. Persistence refers to the impact that actions have on a payoff-relevant state variable, e.g. the quality of a product depends on both current and past investment choices. I characterize actions and payoffs in Markov Perfect Equilibria (MPE) for a fixed discount rate, show that the perfect public equilibrium (PPE) payoff set is the convex hull of the MPE payoff set, and derive sufficient conditions for a MPE to be the unique PPE. These results illustrate how persistence provides a channel for effective intertemporal incentives in a setting where traditional channels fail. Applications to persistent product quality, policy targeting, and complementary investment demonstrate how the structure of persistence impacts the strength of incentives and the dynamics of equilibrium behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究在连续时间随机博弈中，过去选择的持续性如何被用来创造激励。一个大型参与人，例如一家企业，与一系列小型参与人，例如顾客，进行互动。大型参与人面临道德风险，其行为只能被不完全观测——它们受到布朗运动的扰动。持续性指的是行为对与支付相关的状态变量的影响，例如产品质量同时取决于当前和过去的投资选择。我刻画了在固定贴现率下马尔可夫完美均衡（MPE）中的行为和支付，证明了完美公共均衡（PPE）支付集是MPE支付集的凸包，并推导了MPE成为唯一PPE的充分条件。这些结果说明了在传统渠道失效的情形中，持续性如何为有效的跨期激励提供渠道。对持续性产品质量、政策 targeting 和互补性投资的应用展示了持续性的结构如何影响激励强度以及均衡行为的动态。

articles.title_en: Optimal contests with incomplete information and convex effort costs
articles.title_cn: 不完全信息与凸努力成本下的最优竞赛
authors: Zhang, Mengxi (Department of Economics, University of Bonn)
articles.abstract_en: I investigate the design of effort-maximizing mechanisms when agents have both private information and convex effort costs, and the designer has a fixed prize budget. I first demonstrate that it is always optimal for the designer to utilize a contest with as many participants as possible. Further, I identify a necessary and sufficient condition for the winner-takes-all prize structure to be optimal. When this condition fails, the designer may prefer to award multiple prizes of descending sizes. I also provide a characterization of the optimal prize allocation rule for this case. Finally, I illustrate how the optimal prize distribution evolves as the contest size grows.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了当代理人同时拥有私人信息和凸努力成本，且设计者拥有固定奖金预算时，努力最大化机制的设计。我首先证明，设计者采用尽可能多参与者的竞赛总是最优的。此外，我确定了赢者通吃奖金结构最优的一个必要且充分条件。当该条件不满足时，设计者可能更倾向于颁发多个规模递减的奖项。我还对此情形下的最优奖金分配规则进行了刻画。最后，我说明了最优奖金分布如何随着竞赛规模的增长而演变。

articles.title_cn: 第一价格拍卖中的最坏情况均衡
authors: Gretschko, Vitali (University of Mannheim, Deparment of Economics)
Mass, Helene (University of Bonn, Institute for Microeconomics)
Vitali Gretschko
articles.abstract_en: The usual analysis of bidding in first-price auctions assumes that bidders know the distribution of valuations. We analyze first-price auctions in which bidders do not know the precise distribution of their competitors' valuations, but only the mean of the distribution. We propose a novel equilibrium solution concept based on worst-case reasoning. We find an essentially unique and efficient worst-case equilibrium of the first-price auction, which has appealing properties from both the bidders' and the seller's point of view.
articles.abstract_cn: 对第一价格拍卖中出价的通常分析假设竞标者知道估值的分布。我们分析竞标者不知道其竞争对手估值的确切分布、而只知道分布均值的第一价格拍卖。我们基于最坏情况推理提出了一种新的均衡解概念。我们找到了第一价格拍卖的一个本质上唯一且有效的最坏情况均衡，该均衡从竞标者和卖方的角度来看都具有吸引人的性质。

articles.title_en: Wages as signals of worker mobility
articles.title_cn: 工资作为工人流动性的信号
authors: Chen, Yu (Department of Economics, University of Calgary)
Doyle, Matthew (Department of Economics, University of Waterloo)
Gonzalez, Francisco M. (Department of Economics, University of Waterloo)
Matthew Doyle
Francisco M. Gonzalez
articles.abstract_en: We analyze a model in which workers direct their search on and off the job and employer-worker match productivities are private information. Employers can commit neither to post contracts such that wages are a function of tenure nor to disregard counteroffers. In this context, potential employers who do not observe workers' productivity in their current matches use wages as a signal of workers' willingness to switch jobs. In turn, this implies that the wage contracts that employers post in the market for entry jobs --- the jobs unemployed workers search for --- not only direct job search but also signal future worker mobility. When the costs of creating entry jobs are sufficiently small, the unique equilibrium supports the efficient allocation under full information. When the costs of creating entry jobs are sufficiently large, the efficient equilibrium may break down because match-specific risk gives rise to a holdup problem in the market for entry jobs. Then, the unique equilibrium may fail to reveal match productivities in the market for entry jobs. The non-revealing equilibrium features wage posting --- pooling wage contracts --- as well as counteroffers, which eliminates the holdup problem at the cost of distorting worker mobility.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一个模型，其中工人在在职和离职状态下指导其搜索，且雇主与工人之间的匹配生产率是私人信息。雇主既不能承诺发布工资是任期函数的合同，也不能承诺无视还价。在这种背景下，未观察到工人当前匹配中生产率的潜在雇主使用工资作为工人愿意转换工作的信号。反过来，这意味着雇主在入门工作市场——失业工人所搜索的工作——发布的工资合同不仅指导求职，还预示着未来的工人流动性。当创造入门工作的成本足够小时，唯一均衡支持完全信息下的有效配置。当创造入门工作的成本足够大时，有效均衡可能破裂，因为匹配特定风险在入门工作市场中引发了套牢问题。然后，唯一均衡可能无法在入门工作市场中揭示匹配生产率。非揭示均衡具有工资发布——混同工资合同——以及还价的特点，这以扭曲工人流动性为代价消除了套牢问题。

authors: Sun, Yiman (CERGE-EI, Charles University and the Economics Institute of the Czech Academy of Sciences)
articles.abstract_en: We study the interaction between an agent of uncertain type, whose project gives rise to both good and bad news, and an evaluator who must decide if and when to fire the agent. The agent can hide bad news from the evaluator at some cost, and will do so if this secures her a significant increase in tenure. When bad news is conclusive, censorship hurts the evaluator, the good agent, and possibly the bad agent. However, when bad news is inconclusive, censorship may benefit all those players. This is because the good agent censors bad news more aggressively than the bad agent, which improves the quality of information.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个类型不确定的代理人（其项目既会产生好消息也会产生坏消息）与一个必须决定是否以及何时解雇该代理人的评估者之间的互动。代理人可以以一定成本向评估者隐瞒坏消息，并且如果这样做能确保其任期显著延长，她就会这样做。当坏消息是决定性的时，审查会损害评估者、好代理人，并可能损害坏代理人。然而，当坏消息是非决定性的时，审查可能使所有这些参与方受益。这是因为好代理人比坏代理人更积极地审查坏消息，从而提高了信息质量。

articles.title_en: Asset bubbles and product market competition
articles.title_cn: 资产泡沫与产品市场竞争
authors: Queirós, Francisco (CSEF and Department of Economics and Statistics, Università di Napoli Federico II)
Francisco Queiros
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the interplay between asset bubbles and product market competition. It offers two main insights. The first is that imperfect competition creates a wedge between interest rates and the marginal product of capital. This makes rational bubbles possible even when there is no overaccumulation of capital. The second is that, when providing a production subsidy, bubbles stimulate competition and reduce monopoly rents. I show that bubbles can destroy efficient investment and have ambiguous welfare consequences. However, when they stimulate competition, they can have crowding-in effects on capital.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究资产泡沫与产品市场竞争之间的相互作用。它提供了两个主要见解。第一个是不完全竞争在利率与资本边际产品之间造成了一个楔子。这使得即使不存在资本过度积累，理性泡沫也成为可能。第二个是，在提供生产补贴时，泡沫刺激竞争并减少垄断租金。我表明，泡沫可以破坏有效投资，并具有模糊的福利后果。然而，当它们刺激竞争时，它们可以对资本产生挤入效应。

articles.title_cn: 利用网络中的社会影响
authors: Nora, Vladyslav (Department of Economics, Nazarbayev University)
Winter, Eyal (The Federmann Center for the Study of Rationality, Hebrew University)
articles.abstract_en: We study binary action network games with strategic complementarities. An agent acts if the aggregate social influence of her friends exceeds a transfer levied on the agent by a principal. The principal seeks to maximize her revenue while inducing everyone to act in a unique equilibrium. We characterize optimal transfers showing that agents who are more popular than their friends receive preferential treatment. Our main result is that under mild conditions complete core–periphery networks deliver the highest revenue to the principal. Furthermore, we show that the revenue is higher in networks where links are allocated unequally across agents. Hence, the principal benefits from creating “influentials” by linking well-connected hubs to less popular periphery.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究具有策略互补性的二元行动网络博弈。如果代理人朋友的总社会影响超过委托人向该代理人征收的转移支付，则该代理人会采取行动。委托人寻求在诱导所有人在唯一均衡中采取行动的同时最大化其收益。我们刻画了最优转移支付，表明比其朋友更受欢迎的代理人会获得优惠待遇。我们的主要结果是，在温和条件下，完全核心— periphery 网络为委托人带来最高收益。此外，我们表明，在链接在代理人之间分配不均的网络中，收益更高。因此，委托人通过将连接良好的枢纽与不太受欢迎的 periphery 相连接来创造“影响者”，从而获益。

authors: Kang, Kee-Youn (School of Business, Yonsei University)
Kee-Youn Kang
articles.abstract_en: We develop a monetary model in which a private company issues digital currency and uses payment data to estimate consumers' preferences. Sellers purchase preference information to produce goods that better match consumers' preferences. A monopoly arises in the digital currency industry, and digital currency is not issued if the inflation rate is sufficiently high. Due to reinforcing interactions between the value of preference information and trade volume, multiple equilibria (with and without digital currency) can exist depending on market structures for monetary exchanges. When left to market forces alone, socially efficient uses of payment data may not occur.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个货币模型，其中一家私人公司发行数字货币并利用支付数据来估计消费者的偏好。卖家购买偏好信息以生产更符合消费者偏好的商品。数字货币行业出现垄断，如果通货膨胀率足够高，数字货币就不会被发行。由于偏好信息的价值与交易量之间的强化互动，根据货币交换的市场结构，可能存在多重均衡（有数字货币和没有数字货币）。当仅由市场力量决定时，支付数据的社会高效利用可能不会发生。

articles.title_cn: 具有溢出效应的非对称全支付拍卖
authors: Betto, Maria (Department of Economics, Northwestern University)
Thomas, Matthew W. (Department of Economics, Northwestern University)
Matthew Wildrick Thomas
articles.abstract_en: When opposing parties compete for a prize, the sunk effort players exert during the conflict can affect the value of the winner's reward. These spillovers can have substantial influence on the equilibrium behavior of participants in applications such as lobbying, warfare, labor tournaments, marketing, and R&D races. To understand this influence, we study a general class of asymmetric, two-player all-pay auctions where we allow for spillovers in each player's reward. The link between participants' efforts and rewards yields novel effects -- in particular, players with higher costs and lower values than their opponent sometimes extract larger payoffs.
articles.abstract_cn: 当对立双方争夺一项奖品时，冲突中参与者投入的沉没努力会影响获胜者奖励的价值。这些溢出效应可能在游说、战争、劳动竞赛、营销和研发竞赛等应用中，对参与者的均衡行为产生重大影响。为了理解这种影响，我们研究了一类一般的非对称、两人全支付拍卖，其中允许每个参与者的奖励存在溢出效应。参与者努力与奖励之间的联系产生了新颖效应——特别是，成本更高、价值低于对手的参与者有时会获得更大的收益。

articles.title_en: Optimal delegation and information transmission under limited awareness
articles.title_cn: 有限意识下的最优授权与信息传递
authors: Auster, Sarah (Department of Economics, University of Bonn)
Pavoni, Nicola (Department of Economics, Bocconi University)
Nicola Pavoni
articles.abstract_en: We study the delegation problem between a principal and an agent, who not only has better information about the performance of the available actions but also superior awareness of the set of actions that are actually feasible. We provide conditions under which the agent finds it optimal to leave the principal unaware of relevant options. By doing so, the agent increases the principal's cost of distorting the agent's choices and increases the principal's willingness to grant him higher information rents. We further show that the principal may use the option of renegotiation as a tool to implement actions that are not describable to her at the contracting stage. If the agent renegotiates, his proposal signals information about the payoff state. Due to her limited awareness, the principal makes a coarse inference from the agent's recommendations and, as a result, accepts a large number of the agent's proposals, which ultimately benefits both.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究委托人与代理人之间的授权问题，代理人不仅对可用行动的表现拥有更好的信息，而且对实际可行的行动集合拥有更优越的意识。我们提供了条件，在这些条件下，代理人发现让委托人不知道相关选项是最优的。通过这样做，代理人增加了委托人扭曲代理人选择的成本，并增加了委托人给予他更高信息租金的意愿。我们进一步表明，委托人可以将重新谈判的选项作为实施在缔约阶段无法向她描述的行动的工具。如果代理人重新谈判，他的提议会传递关于收益状态的信息。由于她的有限意识，委托人从代理人的建议中做出粗略推断，结果接受了大量代理人的提议，这最终使双方受益。

articles.title_en: Sophisticated banking contracts and fragility when withdrawal information is public
articles.title_cn: 当提款信息公开时，复杂的银行合约与脆弱性
authors: Huang, Xuesong (Lingnan College, Sun Yat-sen University)
articles.abstract_en: I study whether self-fulfilling bank runs can occur when banks use sophisticated contracts and withdrawal decisions are public information. In a finite-agent version of Diamond and Dybvig (1983) with correlated types, I first present an example in which a bank run perfect Bayesian equilibrium exists. However, its existence relies on off-path beliefs that are unreasonable in terms of forward induction. To discipline beliefs, I use forward induction equilibrium (Cho, 1987) as the solution concept. I show that, whenever the allocation rule is strictly incentive compatible, the truth-telling strategy is the unique forward induction equilibrium in the withdrawal game, and no bank run occurs. Therefore, with forward induction, sophisticated contracts can prevent bank runs when there is public information about withdrawal decisions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究当银行使用复杂合约且提款决策为公开信息时，是否会发生自我实现的银行挤兑。在具有相关类型的Diamond和Dybvig（1983）的有限代理人版本中，我首先给出一个存在银行挤兑完美贝叶斯均衡的例子。然而，其存在依赖于在前向归纳意义上不合理的非路径信念。为了约束信念，我使用前向归纳均衡（Cho，1987）作为解概念。我证明，只要配置规则是严格激励相容的，说真话策略就是提款博弈中唯一的前向归纳均衡，并且不会发生银行挤兑。因此，在前向归纳下，当存在关于提款决策的公开信息时，复杂合约可以防止银行挤兑。

authors: Liang, Annie (Department of Economics, Northwestern University)
Madsen, Erik (Department of Economics, New York University)
articles.abstract_en: ``Big data" gives markets access to previously unmeasured characteristics of individual agents. Policymakers must decide whether and how to regulate the use of this data. We study how new data affects incentives for agents to exert effort in settings such as the labor market, where an agent's quality is initially unknown but is forecast from an observable outcome. We show that measurement of a new covariate has a systematic effect on the average effort exerted by agents, with the direction of the effect determined by whether the covariate is informative about long-run quality or about a shock to short-run outcomes. For a class of covariates satisfying a statistical property we call strong homoskedasticity, this effect is uniform across agents. More generally, new measurements can impact agents unequally, and we show that these distributional effects have a first-order impact on social welfare.
articles.abstract_cn: “大数据”使市场能够获取个体代理人此前未被测量的特征。政策制定者必须决定是否以及如何监管这些数据的使用。我们研究新数据如何影响代理人在诸如劳动力市场等环境中付出努力的激励，在这些环境中，代理人的质量最初未知，但根据可观察的结果进行预测。我们表明，对新协变量的测量对代理人付出的平均努力具有系统性影响，影响的方向取决于该协变量是关于长期质量的信息，还是关于短期结果冲击的信息。对于一类满足我们称为强同方差性的统计性质的协变量，这种影响在代理人之间是均匀的。更一般地，新的测量可能不平等地影响代理人，并且我们表明这些分配效应对社会福利具有一阶影响。

authors: Barilla, César (Columbia University, Department of Economics)
Gonçalves, Duarte (University College London, Department of Economics)
Duarte Goncalves
articles.abstract_en: We study a model in which two players with opposing interests try to alter a status quo through instability-generating actions. We show that instability can be used to secure longer-term durable changes, even if it is costly to generate and does not generate short-term gains. In equilibrium, instability generated by a player decreases when the status quo favors them more. Equilibrium always exhibits a region of stable states in which the status quo persists. As players' threat power increases, this region shrinks, ultimately collapsing to a single stable state that is supported via a deterrence mechanism. There is long-run path-dependency and inequity: although instability eventually leads to a stable state, it typically selects the least favorable one for the initially disadvantaged player.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究一个模型，其中两个利益对立的参与者试图通过产生不稳定的行动来改变现状。我们表明，不稳定可以被用来确保更长期的持久变化，即使产生不稳定的代价高昂且不会带来短期收益。在均衡中，当一个参与者从现状中获益更多时，该参与者产生的不稳定会减少。均衡总是表现出一个稳定状态的区域，在该区域中现状持续存在。随着参与者威胁力量的增加，这个区域缩小，最终坍缩为一个通过威慑机制支持的单一稳定状态。存在长期路径依赖和不平等：尽管不稳定最终会导致一个稳定状态，但它通常为最初处于不利地位的参与者选择最不利的状态。

authors: Hinnosaar, Toomas (School of Economics, University of Nottingham)
Toomas Hinnosaar
articles.abstract_en: I study sequential contests where the efforts of earlier players may be disclosed to later players by nature or by design. The model has many applications, including rent seeking, R&D, oligopoly, public goods provision, and tragedy of the commons. I show that information about other players' efforts increases the total effort. Thus, the total effort is maximized with full transparency and minimized with no transparency. I also show that in addition to the first-mover advantage, there is an earlier-mover advantage. Finally, I derive the limits for large contests and discuss the limit to perfectly competitive outcomes under different disclosure rules.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究序贯竞赛，其中较早参与者的努力可能由自然或设计向较晚参与者披露。该模型有许多应用，包括寻租、研发、寡头垄断、公共品提供和公地悲剧。我表明，关于其他参与者努力的信息会增加总努力。因此，总努力在完全透明下最大化，在无透明下最小化。我还表明，除了先动优势外，还存在较早行动者优势。最后，我推导了大型竞赛的极限，并讨论了不同披露规则下向完全竞争结果的极限。
